text.tspan: Source records under NF1–5: first completions, non-duplicated new knowledge, individual practice attempts and actual learning days. Activity recording is detailed in SD-12.3.

SRS-based logical interaction model. Boundary / API / control lifelines represent responsibilities, not unspecified code classes, methods, endpoints or HTTP status codes. UI labels and messages are translated into English for these diagrams; SRS message IDs are retained.
Preconditions: valid session, required role, active Student account; JWT authentication under Section 5.2.1. Viewing progress does not modify completion records or practice results.
